# llm_gpu_toolkit

> Browse stored Ollama model metadata and compare a rough VRAM estimate with your GPU memory. This is a planning aid, not a hardware benchmark or a guarantee that a model will run.

- [English](https://github.com/jammyfu/llm_gpu_toolkit/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [简体中文](https://github.com/jammyfu/llm_gpu_toolkit/blob/main/README.md)
- [繁體中文（臺灣）](https://github.com/jammyfu/llm_gpu_toolkit/blob/main/README.zh-TW.md)
- [日本語](https://github.com/jammyfu/llm_gpu_toolkit/blob/main/README.ja.md)
- [한국어](https://github.com/jammyfu/llm_gpu_toolkit/blob/main/README.ko.md)

Root index.html uses a file-size heuristic, not a context/KV-cache/training model. No LICENSE file; confirm permission before reuse. Collector currently disables TLS verification on some requests.
